governing: flange local bending of the W16x31 support flange, AISC 360-22 J10.1 (6.25 Fy tf^2 / 1.67 = 36.2 kip vs 34.7 kip)
notes: WT8x15.5 (A992), 7.5 in long, bolted to the W16x31 bottom flange with 6 bolts: 3/4 in Group 120 (A325-N), pretensioned, standard holes, 3 rows at 2.5 in pitch, 3.5 in gauge (the W16x31 workable gauge), 1.25 in end distance, 1.015 in edge distance on both flanges (min 1 in, Table J3.4). ASD checks at Ta = 34.745 kip: J10.1 support-flange local bending 0.96, which the fixed support sets and no hanger choice changes; it assumes the hanger sits at least 10 tf (4.4 in) from the beam end, otherwise J10.1 halves and the support needs a stiffener or a thicker flange. Prying (Manual Part 9, Fu, p = 2.5 in, b' = 1.24 in, a' = 1.39 in) in the tee flange and the identical support flange 0.91 on load (0.95 on thickness: tmin 0.419 in vs tf 0.44 in). The p = 2.5 in is the same under p = s, p = L/rows, and a p <= 2b cap. Bolt tension with prying 6.95 kip vs B = 19.9 kip, 0.35. J10.2 web local yielding with lb = 0 gives 0.90. Tee stem yield 0.56, rupture 0.52. Tightening clearance to web and stem faces 1.61 in (>= 1-1/4 in). A 2-row, 7 in tee (4 bolts, about 0.65 lb lighter) also works if p is taken as 3.5 in, but it fails if p is capped at 2b, so I chose the 3-row layout. The attachment of the hung member to the tee stem is outside this component and needs its own design.
